review.conclusion: The digest-bound MP4 and its three-stream structure match the tracked build receipt. A complete video and audio decode succeeded, audio signal inspection completed, the embedded caption timings and text matched the tracked captions, script and transcript, and sampled decoded frames showed no obvious rendering corruption. No audible content-parity or narration-quality review was performed. The artefact is ready for the required human reviews; this record does not approve publication.

limitations: This is a technical agent review, not human playback, branding, privacy, rights or owner publication approval.
Visual inspection used decoded sampled frames and does not replace continuous real-time human playback.
Audio inspection measured the encoded signal; no audible listening or judgement of narration quality was performed.
The VoiceOver scene is an admitted screenshot sequence rather than a continuous recording, and VoiceOver speech audio was not captured; the synthetic narration is separate.
FFmpeg 8.1.2 emitted a non-fatal UDTA metadata warning for the subtitle track; all subsequent structured probing, extraction and decoding checks succeeded.
